_comment: Hand-maintained, per item, keyed on the Vinted item id. Always wins over the rules in
taxonomy.json. This is where curation lives:
"category": "Spirituality"   move an item into a category Vinted has no concept of
"featured": true             pin it to the homepage strip
"hidden":   true             keep it on Vinted but off this site
Only list items that need one of those. Everything else is derived automatically and
should stay out of this file.
The Spirituality entries below are a first pass — Vinted files deity statues under
'Bydlení Sochy a figuríny' (home / figurines) and prayer beads under jewellery, which
is structurally right and commercially wrong. Move anything you disagree with back by
_sold_comment: The seven items in sold-seed.json. Vinted strips the category from a sold listing, so
there is nothing to map — these are set by hand from their titles, all clothing and
accessories. Without this they would collect in 'More'.
